reference.title: Build whisper and murmur agent-communication infrastructure
reference.summary: Continued a prior design and landed the full whispering (system-to-agent) and murmuring (agent-to-agent via system) infrastructure across two phases. Phase 1 built WhisperStore (SQLite-backed, WAL-mode, auto-recovering), WhisperScheduler with periodic sources and a prune tick, WhisperRegistry, IPC handlers, the CLI delivery path via emitWhispers(), and ox doctor auto-fix for DB corruption. Phase 2 added the murmur pub/sub system: topic filtering, importance levels (critical/normal/ambient), attention thresholds, the ox murmur CLI, the MurmurRelay daemon component, and a temporal file layout with rolling 12-hour sparse checkout. The architectural decisions locked in during the session — SQLite over Dolt, two physical DBs (ledger- and team-scoped), voice-metaphor naming, and optional human-only principal identity for now — are called out explicitly. 25 files, 4,644 insertions pushed on ryan/whispering.
